evidence.note: The entire project is an ETL system: 22 fetcher modules extract data, ETL modules transform, and the actor model loads unified classifications.
Each fetcher module uses a base class (EdgarFetcher, YfinanceFetcher, etc.) that provides rate limiting, HTTP methods, and file saving; subclasses implement specific fetch logic.
22 Registry classes (SecRegistry, YahooRegistry, etc.) declare Service.Identity objects; combined in root registry.py.
Each fetcher base class uses infra_client.api_clients.RateLimiter with source-specific limits (SEC: 10 req/s, Yahoo: 2 req/s, FRED: 2 req/s).
Fund algorithm pipeline runs name_patterns -> prospectus_parser -> algorithm_classifier -> nport_inference -> reconciliation -> validation as ordered stages with dependencies.
Multiple classification strategies (regex patterns, LLM, holdings analysis, known-filer lookup) used interchangeably for the same classification task.
etl.mv_stock_ownership is a PostgreSQL materialized view aggregating per-stock ownership by actor type and predictability.
ProjectCLI from orchestrator framework manages service lifecycle: start, stop, status, list, run, kill, health.
All fetcher base classes bind structured fields to _logger (fetcher name) for Grafana filtering via infra-client.
Every service has a cron_schedule and extends ScheduledService; orchestrator runs services per cron.
Pagination limits (1000, 5000, 50000) and batch sizes hardcoded inline rather than as named constants, though they represent API constraints.

gaps.relevance: 22 fetcher modules make HTTP calls to external APIs; no circuit breaker detected for any of them
gaps.recommendation: Add circuit breaker (e.g., pybreaker) to fetcher base classes to prevent cascading failures when an external API is down for an extended period.

gaps.relevance: External HTTP calls fail on transient errors (network timeouts, 5xx); no retry with backoff detected
gaps.recommendation: Add retry with exponential backoff (e.g., tenacity or urllib3 Retry) to base fetcher HTTP methods. The cron-based retry-on-next-schedule is coarse-grained.

gaps.relevance: Validator modules exist (fetchers/sec/validators.py, etc.) but validation is not systematically applied at all ingestion boundaries
gaps.recommendation: Ensure all fetcher services validate external API responses before persisting to prevent corrupt data propagation.

gaps.relevance: CLI health command exists but no programmatic health endpoint; services lack individual health probes
gaps.recommendation: Add per-service health check endpoints for monitoring infrastructure to probe.

infrastructure.notes: Schema-isolated tables per fetcher (sec.*, yahoo.*, finra.*, etc.) plus etl.* for derived data
Referenced in INFRA_MONITORS for health monitoring; no direct publish/subscribe in fetcher code
Structured logs with fetcher context for Grafana filtering

gaps: No distributed tracing across service pipeline stages
No correlation IDs linking fetcher runs to downstream ETL processing

debt.interpretation: Moderate debt driven by missing resilience patterns across all 22 external API integrations and absence of test infrastructure.

violations.anti_pattern: No circuit breaker on external API calls
violations.detail: All 22 fetcher modules make external HTTP calls with rate limiting and timeouts but no circuit breaker; a prolonged API outage causes repeated failures.

violations.anti_pattern: No retry with backoff on transient failures
violations.detail: Transient errors (network glitches, 5xx) cause immediate service failure; retry only occurs at next cron schedule which may be hours or days away.
No test framework, test files, or test configuration found. The backtesting component validates predictions but there are no unit or integration tests for the code itself.
7 TODO/FIXME markers found across source files indicating incomplete implementation.
Validator modules exist for some fetchers but are not systematically applied; external API responses could contain unexpected formats.
API pagination limits (1000, 5000, 50000) are inline literals rather than named constants or config values.

violations.anti_pattern: No correlation IDs across pipeline stages
violations.detail: Structured logging binds fetcher name but no correlation ID linking a fetcher run to its downstream ETL processing, making cross-stage debugging difficult.

recommendations.title: Add retry and circuit breaker to fetcher base classes
recommendations.description: Add tenacity retry with exponential backoff and pybreaker circuit breaker to the base HTTP methods (_get, _post, _get_json). This single change fixes both CRITICAL violations across all 22 fetcher modules since they all inherit from these base classes.

recommendations.title: Add test infrastructure
recommendations.description: Set up pytest with fixtures for database mocking and HTTP response stubbing. Start with the highest-value targets: the classification logic in filer_13f_classifier.py and algorithm_classifier.py where bugs silently propagate through the entire pipeline.

recommendations.title: Systematize data validation at ingestion boundaries
recommendations.description: Ensure every fetcher service validates external API responses before persisting. Extend existing validator modules to all fetchers and call them consistently.

recommendations.title: Add correlation IDs to pipeline execution
recommendations.description: Generate a run_id at service start and propagate it through structured logging context so that fetcher runs can be traced to their downstream ETL processing in Grafana.
